caseName: Cleveland, Cincinnati, Chicago, & St. Louis Ry. Co. v. Henry
caseNameFull: Cleveland, Cincinnati, Chicago, & St. Louis Ry. Co. v. Henry, Administratrix
attorneys: Messrs. H. N. Quigley, S. W. Baxter, and W. D. Chapman for petitioner. Messrs. Wm. H. Allen and John S. Marsalek for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Missouri denied for the want of a final judgment. Bruce v. Tobin, 245 U.S. 18; Johnson v. Keith, 117 U.S. 199; Houston v. Moore, 3 Wheat. 433.
